errors.deadline: Pick a date from today on.

confirm.closeDescription_other: {{count}} of {{total}} items have a chosen supplier. Chosen prices go into the catalog price history and the link stops accepting answers.
confirm.cancelDescription: Links stop accepting answers and no price goes into the catalog.

addSupplier.description: They get their own link to answer this quotation.
addSupplier.label: Supplier

manual.description: Enter the proposal received by e-mail, phone or PDF. It counts as the supplier's answer.

errors.price: Enter the price or mark “Not available”.
errors.name: Enter your name.

public.greeting: Hello, {{fornecedor}}! Please enter your prices for the requested materials below.
public.canEdit: You can change it until the deadline.
public.refusedBanner: On {{date}} you said you won't quote.

closed.PRAZO: The deadline to answer has passed.

public.sendError: Could not send. Please try again.
public.declineDescription: Let the buyer know; you can explain why if you like.
public.declined: Decline recorded. Thanks for letting us know.

openLink.title: Open link for suppliers
openLink.description: Share this link: any supplier sees the list, enters their CNPJ and quotes on it. New companies come in as pending registrations for you to approve.
openLink.off: The open link is off — only invited suppliers can answer.
openLink.hint: Each supplier gets their own answer link after entering the CNPJ — one supplier never sees another's prices.
openLink.regenerateDescription: The current link stops working. Suppliers who already joined keep their own answer link.
openLink.disableDescription: New suppliers will no longer be able to join through it. Suppliers who already joined keep their own answer link.
openLink.moreItems_one: • … and {{count}} more item in the link
openLink.moreItems_other: • … and {{count}} more items in the link
